features.SKY: The vanilla sky colour and sun
features.FOG: Distance fog at the edge of the view
features.WEATHER: Rain, snow and thunder, unless a Lighting drives them
features.DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE: Time moves on its own, unless a Lighting sets the clock
features.AMBIENT_LIGHT: Blocks and parts get sky and block light
features.BLOCK_ENTITIES: Chests, signs and other block entities work
features.ITEM_DROPS: Broken blocks and deaths drop items

features.VANILLA_MOVEMENT: Minecraft moves the player, turn off to drive the Humanoid from scripts
features.DEATH_SCREEN: The vanilla death screen with its respawn button

features.HOTBAR: The hotbar at the bottom of the screen
features.TITLE_SCREEN: Launching shows the title screen instead of joining the place

features.PLAYER_MODEL: Players are drawn with the vanilla model
features.VANILLA_SOUNDS: Footsteps, blocks and other game sounds

features.HTTP_REQUESTS: Server scripts may reach websites with http.request
